name: Synthetic metadata inspection and evidence linkage
description: Inspectable capability descriptor for Sewall.ai's bounded fixture controller. All records, policies, and links are fictional. Internal operation identifiers describe existing code branches; this file is not a plugin installer or an executable tool registry.

tools.description: Inspect an invented source record after an offline fixture policy allow decision; retain record digest and provenance.
Compare explicit specimen, taxon, or site identifiers; inspect historical feature interval and availability. Preserve rejected and unresolved links.

conditions: Mode is synthetic_fixture and all source records originate in sewall.fixtures.
Focus is cross-scale, traits, molecular, or landscape; auto focus is resolved by the bounded planner.
Inspection requires an allow decision for the supplied fictional policy and request.
Verification requires every source selected by the explicit linkage rule to be available.
exclusions: Real biological inference, expression analysis, participant genotype retrieval, and causal claims.
Real compute-to-data execution, agreement signing, authorization grants, and live repository credentials.
Treating a shared taxon, author address, or literature mention as a matched specimen.
failure_behavior: Policy review or denial blocks source inspection and dependent conclusions.
Unavailable sources, missing identifiers, and temporal leakage remain visible in graph status and limitations.
A step budget bounds execution; exhausted runs retain their partial trace and failed status.

inputs.name: question
inputs.description: Scientist's requested metadata question; 1 to 4000 characters.

inputs.name: focus
inputs.description: auto, cross-scale, traits, molecular, or landscape.

inputs.name: scenario
inputs.description: coastal, missing-link, policy-review, policy-denied, source-failure, or future-leakage.

inputs.name: max_steps
inputs.description: Controller step budget from 1 to 100; default 30.

inputs.name: previous
inputs.description: Prior manifest for a revised question; integrity must pass and total revisions may not exceed ten.

outputs.name: research_manifest
outputs.description: Fixture graph, policy assessments, draft-only requests, limitations, event chain, metrics, and content digest; scientific claims remain empty.

limitations: Evidence fields describe software fixtures, not measurements or validated scientific findings.
Temporal comparison uses explicitly formatted fictional dates and cannot establish real historical data availability.
Hashes support comparison against a retained digest; they are not signatures or independent proof of authenticity.

compute.placement_notice: The fictional source compute location is a policy label. The current controller executes locally and makes no claim of real remote computation.

policy_constraints.attribution: Retain the fictional source attribution marker; real item-level licensing requires a separate validated adapter.
policy_constraints.audit: Record policy decisions, graph changes, source failures, rejected links, and run status in the event chain.

acceptance: Every fixture focus and scenario, budget stop, and question revision satisfies the manifest schema.
Malformed nested fields, elevated live-access claims, and nonempty biological claims fail schema validation.
Graph integrity and deterministic replay must be checked separately from JSON Schema validation.
